optimized_sql:
WITH store_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
),
web_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
),
catalog_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT cd_gender,
           cd_marital_status,
           cd_education_status,
           cd_purchase_estimate,
           cd_credit_rating,
           count(*) AS cnt1
    FROM customer_address ca
    JOIN customer c
      ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
     AND ca.ca_state IN ('IL','TX','ME')
    JOIN customer_demographics
      ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN store_customers
      ON c.c_customer_sk = store_customers.ss_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_customers
      ON c.c_customer_sk = web_customers.ws_bill_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_customers
      ON c.c_customer_sk = catalog_customers.cs_ship_customer_sk
    WHERE web_customers.ws_bill_customer_sk IS NULL
      AND catalog_customers.cs_ship_customer_sk IS NULL
    GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status,
             cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
)
SELECT grouped.cd_gender AS cd_gender,
       grouped.cd_marital_status AS cd_marital_status,
       grouped.cd_education_status AS cd_education_status,
       grouped.cnt1 AS cnt1,
       grouped.cd_purchase_estimate AS cd_purchase_estimate,
       grouped.cnt1 AS cnt2,
       grouped.cd_credit_rating AS cd_credit_rating,
       grouped.cnt1 AS cnt3
FROM grouped
ORDER BY grouped.cd_gender, grouped.cd_marital_status,
         grouped.cd_education_status, grouped.cd_purchase_estimate,
         grouped.cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
